newsitem.title: CANADA: Bovar to take charge in fourth quarter.
newsitem.headline: Bovar to take charge in fourth quarter.

text.p: BOVAR Waste Management, a division of Bovar Inc, said on Tuesday it is closing its Beiseker biomedical waste treatment facility due to the company's consolidation of its waste processing operations at the Swan Hills Treatment Centre.

BOVAR said it has written down the facility on the basis of a recent appraisal of the land and buildings and management's estimate of the resale value of the kiln, pollution control and related equipment. The company will recognize a loss of approximately C$3.6 million with respect to this write-down in the fourth quarter.
The waste previously received for incineration at the Beiseker facility will now be processed at the Swan Hills Treatment Centre.
